description: Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs - Temporarily suspend the registration of the Five National Association/Federations of Sports
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Harin Fernando, Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs) and outlines detailed responsibilities being assigned to another named individual (Professor (Rear Admiral) Shemal Fernando). It contains both "who" (government personnel) and "what" (detailed responsibilities including suspending registrations, appointing a competent authority, and specifying administrative duties and election conduct).
